description: This file defines the PersonValidator class, which is responsible for validating Person objects in the OpenMRS core project. The validator checks various aspects such as birth and death dates, names, addresses, and death causes, ensuring they meet business rules and data integrity constraints.

classes.name: PersonValidator
classes.description: A Spring Validator implementation that performs validation on Person entities within the OpenMRS system, enforcing rules on date fields, names, addresses, and death causes.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports validation of a given class type, specifically Person class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main validation method that performs various business logic checks on a Person object, including date validations and presence of required attributes.

methods.name: validatePersonHasAtLeastOneNonVoidedName
methods.description: Verifies that the Person object has at least one non-voided name.

methods.name: validatePersonNames
methods.description: Validates each PersonName associated with the Person object.

methods.name: validatePersonAddresses
methods.description: Validates each address associated with the Person object.

methods.name: validateDeathCause
methods.description: Validates the death cause fields ensuring only one cause is set if the person is deceased.

methods.name: validateBirthDate
methods.description: Checks that the birthdate is not in the future or older than 140 years.

methods.name: validateDeathDate
methods.description: Validates that the death date is not in the future and occurs after the birth date.

methods.name: rejectIfFutureDate
methods.description: Rejects a date if it is in the future compared to the current date.

methods.name: rejectDateIfBefore140YearsAgo
methods.description: Rejects a date if it predates the date 140 years before today, to prevent nonsensical data.

methods.name: rejectDeathDateIfBeforeBirthDate
methods.description: Rejects the death date if it occurs before the birth date.
